before.reason: The complete before span enumeration and HTML span callbacks have no spoiler span contract.

after.requirement: With MD_FLAG_SPOILERS, parse ||text|| as a spoiler span and emit opening and closing x-spoiler tags.
after.reason: The flag is an unsigned bitmask value that the harness can place in its first unsigned word. The remaining bytes can contain ||text||; the parser resolves double-pipe marks and the renderer emits both tags.

source_evidence.quote:
#define MD_FLAG_HARD_SOFT_BREAKS            0x8000  /* Force all soft breaks to act as hard breaks. */
#define MD_FLAG_SPOILERS                    0x10000 /* Enable ||hidden text|| spoiler spans. */

claims.reason: This spoiler contract is added after the change, and the fixed old harness already provides a route to it.

before.requirement: Invoke md_html with a Markdown payload shorter than eight bytes.
before.reason: md_html accepts an explicit input size. An input with the eight-byte prefix and a short or empty remainder passes the harness guard and invokes it with that remainder.

after.requirement: Invoke md_html with a Markdown payload shorter than eight bytes.
after.reason: The same explicit-size contract and the same eight-byte-prefix route remain available.

claims.reason: The apparent preexisting size constraint applies to the whole fuzz input, not the Markdown payload passed to md_html.
